'''Nadai Pawaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3638 BBY]], Nadai was part of [[Strike Team Oricon]], a unit sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] to confront the powerful rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] known as the [[Dread Masters]]. Nadai sold armor and weaponry, and she often meditated at the team's [[Strike Team Oricon camp|camp]].

==Behind the scenes==
A vendor for the Jedi consular class on Oricon, Nadai was introduced on [[October 1]], [[2013]], in Game Update 2.4 for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''. Pawaro and the rest of the class gear vendors at Oricon, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by standardized vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]]; she was replaced by Master [[Oh'dvek]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
